_about: FFIEC v1 test-vector case 017 partial-disclosure inclusion proof for entry index 3 (seq=4). The audit path follows RFC 6962 §2.1.1 audit-path style with directional-bit encoding per design 07 §10.5. Three levels in the 7-leaf tree; no 'promote' step in this path because L3 lives in the left subtree (the right-promote happens in the right subtree at level 1 with L6).
_audit_path_walk_explanation: Level 0: L3 is at leaf_index 3 (paired with L2 at leaf_index 2). L2 is on the left, the running hash (L3) is on the right. Combine as SHA-256(0x01 || L2 || running).

Level 1: The level-1 node h(L2,L3) is at index 1 within level 1 (paired with h(L0,L1) at index 0). h(L0,L1) is on the left, the running hash is on the right. Combine as SHA-256(0x01 || h(L0,L1) || running).

Level 2: The level-2 node h(h(L0,L1), h(L2,L3)) is at index 0 within level 2 (paired with h(h(L4,L5), L6_promoted) at index 1). The right-subtree root is on the right, the running hash is on the left. Combine as SHA-256(0x01 || running || right_subtree_root).
After the level-2 compression, running == seal.merkle_root. The proof verifies.

audit_path._note: Sibling L2 is on the left. Compress as SHA-256(0x01 || sibling || running).
Sibling h(L0,L1) is on the left at level 1. Compress as SHA-256(0x01 || sibling || running).
Sibling is the right subtree root. Compress as SHA-256(0x01 || running || sibling).

_compression_rule_reminder: leaf_node = SHA-256(0x00 || canonical_bytes); internal_node = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right). Left and right at each level are determined by the directional bit ('left' = sibling is on the left of running; 'right' = sibling is on the right of running). The 0x00 / 0x01 domain separators are RFC 6962 §2.1 — implementations omitting them produce different roots and are non-conformant.
_promote_step_absent_note: This proof has three audit-path steps and no 'promote' step. A proof for L6 (the right-promoted leaf) would carry a 'promote' step at level 1 — sibling_hash_hex = null, position = 'promote' — under which the running hash is carried forward unchanged. See design 07 §10.5 for the 'promote' step shape.
